summary: VERIFIED: The one-line fix at frontend/src/hooks/use-realtime-voice.ts:445 (adding `type: 'realtime'` inside the session object of session.update) resolves the last remaining blocker. Full end-to-end voice-assistant flow now works: mint → SDP handshake (HTTP 201) → data channel open → session.update accepted (no error event) → tool registration successful → user text query 'kitne shipments pending hain?' → model emits response.function_call_arguments.done with name='query_dashboard', args={metric:'pending_shipments'} → client POSTs /api/voice/query (HTTP 200, count=1) → client sends function_call_output + response.create → model speaks final answer 'Sir, 1 shipment pending hai.' (contains the exact number '1' from backend). Zero server errors received throughout the session. Fix is complete and verified.

minor_followups.issue: GA Realtime API emits `response.output_audio_transcript.delta` / `.done` (verified live), but the client hook only branches on `response.output_text.delta` and `response.audio_transcript.delta` (lines 198-209). As a result the visible transcript bubbles stay as '…' placeholders even though audio plays correctly and the underlying text arrives. Add `response.output_audio_transcript.delta` (and optionally `.done`) to the same branch so assistant text renders in-app. Not a blocker for the current fix — audio TTS is heard and the model's answer is verifiably correct.

action_items: OPTIONAL P3 follow-up: add `response.output_audio_transcript.delta` to the transcript-accumulator branch in use-realtime-voice.ts:198 so the on-screen transcript bubbles populate (currently empty — audio still plays).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix at use-realtime-voice.ts:445 (`type: 'realtime'` inside session object) is correct and matches the GA Realtime API discriminator requirement.
Both `fill_form` and `query_dashboard` tool schemas are correctly registered and the model selects the right one for the metric query.
query_dashboard client handler (lines 295-343) correctly pipes: parse args → POST /api/voice/query → push function_call_output → response.create. All 4 network events observed live.
Client transcript branch (line 198) doesn't cover the new GA `response.output_audio_transcript.*` event names — audio works, on-screen text bubbles show '…' placeholders. Minor cosmetic gap.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed. Backend returned live data: pending_shipments count=1, sample consignment AURA-PEN-001, route Bangkok → Chennai.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice-assistant fix chain complete: (1) GA SDP endpoint /v1/realtime/calls, (2) marin voice, (3) query_dashboard live-data tool with session.type='realtime', (4) response.cancelled handling. Live verification captured session.update, all 5 response cycles, and final assistant text 'Sir, 1 shipment pending hai.' Only minor cosmetic follow-up is populating the on-screen transcript from the GA `response.output_audio_transcript.delta` event name.
